title: Pure Ashened
summary: Ashened cards and the Veidos cards they are built around, with generic staples. Awakening of Veidos places Obsidim, the Ashened City from the Deck in either Field Zone, and with Obsidim on the field every Ashened monster summons itself from the hand. Priestess of the Ashened City searches any Ashened card. Veidos the Eruption Dragon of Extinction jumps to the opponent's field from the hand to destroy a Field Spell and fetch an Ashened Continuous Trap. When it is sent from their field to your GY, it destroys every monster. Ashened for Eternity takes Veidos back, and Ashened to Endlessness fuses it with monsters from either field. Obsidim turns their Special Summoned monsters into Pyro on your turn, so they become Fusion material and Embers of the Ashened can destroy them in battle. Inferno of the Ashened isn't out in the TCG yet.

exclude.Inferno of the Ashened: Not released in the TCG yet.

main: Priestess of the Ashened City
Starter: summons itself under Obsidim and searches an Ashened card.
Veidos the Eruption Dragon of Extinction
Jumps to their field to destroy a Field Spell and fetch an Ashened Continuous Trap; wipes the monsters when it comes back.
Hero of the Ashened City
Destroys a Pyro on either Main Phase; destroying Veidos places Obsidim.
King of the Ashened City
Summons an Ashened from the hand, or from the Deck against a 2800-ATK monster.
Shaman of the Ashened City
Shuffles three Pyro back to search Obsidim.
Spearhead of the Ashened City
Tributes itself to bounce a card when they have a 2800-ATK monster.
Obsidim, the Ashened City
Field Spell: turns their Special Summoned monsters Pyro on your turn; replaces itself from the Deck.
Awakening of Veidos
Quick-Play: places Obsidim from the Deck; searches Veidos if they have a Field Spell.
Extinguishing the Ashened
Mills a DARK Pyro and recovers a big Pyro; Fusion Summons from the GY.
Rekindling the Ashened
Quick-Play: recycles an Ashened card to negate a monster.
Ashened for Eternity
Takes Veidos back from their field; recovers Veidos or an Ashened when activated.
Ashened to Endlessness
Fuses Veidos with monsters from either field; turns their monsters Pyro.
extra: Fusion from two Pyro: recovers Obsidim; destroys a Pyro it battles and attacks again.
Veidos the Dragon of Endless Darkness
Fusion boss: wipes their Spells/Traps and destroys a card on activation.
Pyro Rank 4: searches or mills a Pyro.
Rank 4 from two Pyro: banishes three GY monsters when destroyed.
